shape.text: Keys begin nvapi-. NVIDIA's own SDK constant for the scoped key prefix uses it with an executing startswith check, and NVIDIA-owned code treats NGC personal, NGC service and build.nvidia.com keys as sharing the prefix, with no separator or checksum.

After the prefix come at least 60 characters from letters, digits, underscore and hyphen, open-ended. This comes from a secret-scanning rule authored in an NVIDIA-owned organization (added 2026-05-21); a second NVIDIA rule uses a lower floor of 40 with the same class and contradicts nothing. No provider source states an exact width.
Only one looser NVIDIA redaction rule admits a dot in the body, so a body containing a dot is not part of the shape.
One scanner rule expects exactly 64 characters after the prefix and lags provider-grammar values of 60 to 63 and 65 or more; another scanner rule uses a width of 60 to 70; a third has no NVIDIA rule.
A legacy NGC key is 84 non-space characters with no prefix and is used as the password for the $oauthtoken registry login.

unresolved.reason: Its structure is tool-inferred and no provider source states it.

issuance.text: The key is read from the NVIDIA_API_KEY and NGC_API_KEY environment variables and sent as an Authorization Bearer header to integrate.api.nvidia.com, or given as the api_key argument of the chat client.
No NVIDIA key was issued or observed for this record.

collisions.text: Names of the NVAPI SDK and its crates (nvapi-sys, nvapi-rs) begin with the same text but fall below the 60-character floor.
